headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere's mother says she 'sadly lost her way'
headlines.description: Hayden Panettiere's mother Lesley Vogel spoke exclusively to NBC News about her daughter and her on-again-off-again boyfriend. NBC News' Rebecca Keegan has details on a new police report released and what else Vogel had to say.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere’s ex-partner Wladimir Klitschko shares ‘profound shock’ in tribute
headlines.description: Wladimir Klitschko, the former partner of actor Hayden Panettiere said their family is “going through a time of profound shock and grief,” following her death.

headlines.title: Primary Candidates With the Same Name Sparks Confusion
headlines.description: Voters in California, Florida, Wyoming and Alaska are heading to the polls where candidates with the same name in the same race are sparking confusion and harsh accusations. In Alaska, a reliably red state that President Donald Trump carried three times, a Republican incumbent is seeking a third term but has a strong challenger across the aisle whose name sounds a little too familiar. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Penn State Frat Brothers Charged in Alleged Cocaine Trafficking
headlines.description: Thirteen current and former students at Penn State University are charged in connection with an off-campus cocaine ring. Authorities allege senior members of Delta Upsilon and Sigma Chi ran the operation inside their fraternities between 2023 and 2024. Officials say the suspects used new pledges to cut and package the drugs.

headlines.title: States take on Meta in court over child addiction claims
headlines.description: State attorneys general are in court arguing that Meta knowingly created features on its social media platforms that keep children addicted. NBC News' Allie Canal reports on the court case and impact it could have on the tech company.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Gov. Josh Shapiro takes a hard line against ‘predatory’ data center developers in Pennsylvania
headlines.description: Shapiro, a potential Democratic 2028 contender, earlier welcomed data center developments. His new executive order takes a starkly different tone toward the industry.

headlines.title: What two under-the-radar DNC moves say about the party’s direction: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki files a dispatch from the recent Democratic National Committee meeting in Austin. Plus, we preview the key primaries to keep an eye on before polls close tonight.

headlines.title: ‘Dune: Part Three’ sets off early ticket frenzy as fans crash sales sites
headlines.description: Fans eager to see “Dune: Part Three” on the biggest screens in December first had to survive the online ticket queue.

headlines.title: Kaia Gerber says she had an exorcism performed on her with a didgeridoo
headlines.description: Kaia Gerber revealed that she once underwent an exorcism after her parents believed she was “haunted” as a child.

headlines.title: The best styling products to keep flyaway hairs at bay
headlines.description: Our editors spent three months testing hair styling products to keep flyaways, baby hairs and frizz at bay. Shop the best options from Dae, Briogeo, Fenty Beauty and more.

headlines.title: Tick prevention for dogs: Vets explain how to beat the blood-suckers
headlines.description: Dogs are more vulnerable to Lyme disease than ever. These are the best vet-approved tick preventatives for dogs and how to check your dog for ticks.
